text: For the standard Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9), which sequence must immediately follow (3') the 20-nt target site for Cas9 to bind and cut?
explanation: SpCas9 requires an NGG protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) immediately 3' of the target site on the non-template strand. TTTN is the 5' PAM recognized by Cas12a (Cpf1); NNGRRT is the PAM recognized by the smaller SaCas9; and NRN/NYN describes the near-PAMless SpRY variant, not wild-type SpCas9.
